title: Five hand-made rollback tables in public are locked: RLS on, no anon or authenticated access

verify.note: Fails today: the migration does not exist. Live check: the query at the foot of the migration returns zero rows.

detail: The Supabase linter reports rls_disabled_in_public ERROR on zz_backup_free_human_20261029, zz_backup_free_human_blocks_20261030, zz_backup_free_human_page_20261030, zz_backup_free_human_pages_20261030 and zz_backup_alli_rae_update5_20261030 (plus PostGIS spatial_ref_sys, tracked under SEC-002). Measured 2026-11-02 on production: anon and authenticated both hold select, so unpublished Space page content copied for rollback is readable through the REST API. The older zz_backup_* tables already have RLS on. Expected lift: closes a data-exposure ERROR. Also three of these have no primary key (advisor INFO); dropping the copies once the Spaces are signed off is the cleaner end state and is left to the owner.
